description: Free. Project one declared source-separated observation packet into the accepted funnel decision. Caller observations stay declared. Does not fetch URLs, query customers, store the packet, or spend.

packet.description: Caller-supplied neomorphic.funnel-decision-request.v1 core packet or neomorphic.live-measurement-input.v1 consumer packet. The copyable core example requires schema, asOf (your observation time as an ISO UTC string), and sources. Empty sources means no observations, not zero activity. URLs inside it are not fetched.

name: project_funnel_evidence
